title: Why your bonus is taxed more #BonusTax
text:
Your employer works out the tax on your salary for the year with the bonus and without it; the difference is the tax on the bonus. Sipho (an illustration) earns R240,000 a year. With a R20,000 bonus, the first R5,100 still fits in the 18% step, but almost R14,900 spills into the 26% step: R4,792 tax on the bonus, about R24 in every R100, more than double his average rate of about R11. It's not a punishment: every extra rand is taxed at your top rate, never your average rate.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.

Sources
